title: Instellarms 'Shield' Submarine — Deck Plan
description: Pressure hull with bow and stern domes, bulkhead door, and crew chairs.
script:
title: Submarine — Deck Plan
units: m
world: -28, -12, 28, 12
grid: 1.5
wallwidth: 0.25
wallcolor: #1e4a3d
# bow dome — flat right, dome opens left
semicircle: -22, -5.5, -10, 5.5, right, noflatwall
# main pressure hull — nowall so rect edges don't show,
# only the explicit top/bottom wall lines do
rect: -16, -5.5, 4, 5.5, nowall
# top and bottom hull walls
wall: -16, 5.5, 3, 5.5
wall: -16, -5.5, 3, -5.5
# stern dome — flat left, dome opens right
semicircle: -5.5, -5.5, 11.5, 5.5, left, noflatwall
label: -26, -1, -22, 1, Bow
label: -16, 5.5, 3, 8, Pressure Hull
label: 12, -1, 16, 1, Stern
wall: -16.5,5.5,-16.5,-5.5
# sliding door in the bulkhead wall
door: -16.5, 1.5, -16.5, -1.5
# ── component definitions ───────────────────────────────────────────
# chair_rect: ~0.5m square. origin at centre. back faces +Y at angle=0.
@component chair_rect
# seat body
rect: -0.22, -0.22, 0.22, 0.22
# backrest (thick bar at top)
rect: -0.22,  0.22,  0.22, 0.32
# left armrest
rect: -0.30, -0.10, -0.22, 0.22
# right armrest
rect:  0.22, -0.10,  0.30, 0.22
@end
# ── place: name, x, y, scale, angleDeg ──────────────────────────────
place: chair_rect, -18.75, -2.25, 1, 270
place: chair_rect, -18.75, 2.25, 1, 270
